name: credit-after-edits
invariant: A build whose executor hit a 402 after editing is a partial_patch, could_not_run with broker_credit_exhausted, whose value is the controller's diff of the workspace and whose attempt is sealed with that diff as its AttemptRecord's partial_diff, never "no changes" (13 "Facts, not claims"; 05 "AttemptRecord"; 11 intake).
